groups.title: Special districts
groups.note: Municipal, school, and special-district names for 2022–2026 are keyed from official Lincoln clerk November general results in this archive (official 2024 general is an official scan; names and totals were read from that official PDF). Official 2010–2020 Lincoln clerk general summaries are not posted on the current official clerk election-results page, and official SOS Lincoln precinct-by-precinct summaries for those years do not include county, municipal, or school offices, so those earlier January local rows are Not yet collected rather than invented. Mayors of Afton, Alpine, Thayne, Star Valley Ranch, Diamondville, Opal, LaBarge, Cokeville, and Kemmerer appear on official November clerk ballots and are not council-selected. Kemmerer mayor is on the official 2024 clerk (four-year presidential cycle). Cokeville mayor appears on official 2022, 2024, and 2026 clerks and is encoded as two-year terms. Official 2026 certified write-ins (Lincoln County Canvassing Board, November 5, 2026) name additional local winners and are archived. House District 20 appears on official Lincoln ballots beginning in 2022. Official mid-term vacancies are not invented.

groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Local rows are 3rd Judicial District judges (Lincoln, Sweetwater, and Uinta). Where an official Lincoln clerk summary prints only a last name (official 2022 DIST CT - BLUEMEL / CIRCUIT CT - JONES / PROKOS; official 2024 DIST CT - KASTE / CIRCUIT CT - GREER / CORPENING; official 2026 JUDGE C DIST CT JUDGE ROBINSON / JUDGE PROKOS), the full name is taken from an official SOS line or official Wyoming Judicial Branch 3rd JD page, and that source is cited. Judges of other districts are not copied here.
